# create

Create a new web resource from a local file

## Usage

```
ppds webresources create [options]
```

## Arguments

| Name | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `file` | yes | Local file to upload as the web resource content |

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--correlation-id` |  | `string` |  | Correlation ID for distributed tracing |
| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Show trace-level diagnostic output |
| `--display-name` |  | `string` |  | Display name (defaults to the logical name) |
| `--environment` | `-e` | `string` |  | Override the environment URL. Takes precedence over profile's bound environment. |
| `--name` |  | `string` |  | Logical name for the new web resource (e.g., new_/icons/vet.svg) |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--profile` | `-p` | `string` |  | Authentication profile name |
| `--publish` |  | `bool` |  | Publish the web resource after creation (required before it is visible to apps) |
| `--quiet` | `-q` | `bool` |  | Show only warnings and errors |
| `--solution` | `-s` | `string` |  | Solution unique name to add the web resource to |
| `--type` |  | `string` |  | Web resource type override; inferred from the file extension when omitted. One of: html, css, js, xml, png, jpg, gif, xap, xsl, ico, svg, resx |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `bool` |  | Show detailed output including debug messages |
